story.title: GM lays off hundreds of IT workers and rehires for AI-native roles in major workforce pivot
story.summary: General Motors has laid off hundreds of IT employees and is actively replacing them with workers skilled in AI-native development, data engineering, cloud-based engineering, agent and model development, and prompt engineering. The move signals that one of America's largest manufacturers is treating AI competency as a core job requirement rather than a specialist add-on. This is one of the most concrete examples yet of a major non-tech corporation restructuring its entire IT workforce around AI skills.
